The '''S3-D7 Combat Droid''' was a model of humanoid [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Exchange]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The Exchange used a number of S3-D7 droids to patrol the [[Chemical Refinement District]] of the [[Corellian Sector (Nar Shaddaa)/Legends|Corellian Sector]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The S3-D7 Combat Droid appears on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
